name: Mikoto
message: 「Phew... that was a close one.」
Leaving Muragaki and the others in the infirmary, I came out to the embankment by myself.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Man, I’m starving.」
I stretch out my back and pull out a cigarette. As I let the smoke drift into the sea breeze, it vanishes in an instant.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Nothing beats real <d0082>smoke</d>. Electronic cigarettes just don't give you the same satisfaction.」
As I'm catching my breath, a small shadow approaches.

name: Miyako
message: 「Hello, Mr. Fox.」
It was Miyako who had come along.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Who’s a fox? I told you, my name is Sasaki Mikoto.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I bought them, the Inari sushi from Toyohara Konpeidou.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Ooh! For real!？」
I’d asked her on a whim since she said she was bored, but I never expected her to actually get them for me.

name: Miyako
message: 「...Mr. Fox, your ears and tail are showing.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Ah... N-no, it’s just your imagination.」
I hurriedly hide my ears and tail.

name: Mikoto
message: 「See? They’re gone now, aren't they?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hm？ I can still see them.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You... your spiritual sight seems a bit too strong.」
Every once in a while, humans like this show up.
Most of them end up being scouted by the Spirit Agency as spirit mediums and becoming exorcists—my natural enemies...

name: Mikoto
message: 「Whatever, just give me the Inari sushi for now.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Sure, but you promised me a tip, remember?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I know, I know... Here, is this enough？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Ehh~ 500 yen is too little, make it 2,000 yen.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You... for a kid, you sure are money-grubbing!」
I begrudgingly hand the money, including the tip, to Miyako.

name: Miyako
message: 「Yay, thank you!」
Clutching the cash in her hand, she jumps for joy.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Good grief... taking advantage of people like that, you won't turn out to be much of an adult.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Oh, this isn't, like, just a tree leaf or something, is it？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Only a stupid raccoon dog would do something like that.」
As she said this, she opened the inari sushi she had received.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Whoa... looks yummy.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Itadakimasu—nom.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Ahhh, so good... it really hasn't changed at all.」

name: Miyako
message: 「You really love inari sushi that much, huh.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Can't help it, that’s just how it’s decided.」
I’ve known about Miyako for a long time. Before coming to the academy, I was the personal physician for the Suzakuin family.

name: Mikoto
message: 「How old have you turned now, Miyako？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’m nine.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I see. Are you thinking of going home soon?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Nope, not yet.」
It seems she’s really at her wit's end.

name: Mikoto
message: 「How did your old man react when he got angry？」

name: Miyako
message: 「He said things like, ‘Why would you try to activate it at full power right from the start?’」

name: Miyako
message: 「And, ‘It’s one thing that it broke, but you need to reflect on what you did.’」

name: Miyako
message: 「And then he even said, ‘I’m not letting you touch any spirit swords from here on out.’」

name: Miyako
message: 「That’s so mean, and I didn't even do anything wrong.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Geez, that idiot... There are better ways to put it, but he just doesn't have the head for that kind of thing.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Are you talking about Father？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That’s right. For starters, every single sword in the Suzakuin estate is some kind of cursed object anyway.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You not getting hurt is already a gain. He should be happy you're safe first.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Good grief, why are the men of the Suzakuin line all so bad at raising children, generation after generation...」

name: Miyako
message: 「Are they really that bad at it？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, once I start, there's no end to it.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Come to think of it, I left the Suzakuin household because his nagging was just too annoying.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm... So that's why.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Still, Masatane―your father―isn't a bad man. He's way better than that old geezer.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hehe, I think Grandfather is a bad person too.」
She must have found that terribly funny, because she was giggling to herself.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, sooner or later Masatane will realize his mistake and apologize. Forgive him when he does.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I plan to, but... I really can't see Father apologizing.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh, don't worry. Just wait and look forward to it.」
Saying so, I finished off every last piece of the inari sushi Miyako had bought for me.
